$comment: Capability vocabulary for fixtures-vibes Classic scenarios. A scenario tagged @cap-X requires capability X. Runtime profiles claim capabilities; unclaimed ones must be skipped with reason capability-absent. The Piclaw 3.2.5 reference claims all capabilities except those marked reference:false.

@cap-queue.description: Follow-up messages queue while a run is active and are delivered FIFO.

@cap-steer.description: Steering an active run (queue-steer / Enter during run).

@cap-steer-idle.description: Steer action offered while idle. Vibes and tau-prime intentionally disable this.

@cap-stop.description: Stop/abort the active run from the UI.

@cap-quick-actions.description: Quick actions dialog with search and prefill.

@cap-compaction.description: Manual/automatic context compaction surfaced in the UI.

@cap-thoughts.description: Streaming reasoning/thought disclosure in the timeline.

@cap-tool-output.description: Tool calls and results rendered in the timeline.

@cap-read-aloud.description: Read aloud / speech controls on messages.

@cap-session-manage.description: Create, rename, fork, archive sessions from the UI.

@cap-plan-sidebar.description: Session plan sidebar with checklist editor.

@cap-terminal.description: Web terminal pane with a real PTY.

@cap-pwa.description: PWA manifest, install and standalone behaviour.

@cap-touch.description: Touch gestures (swipe, long-press) on phone/tablet projects.

@cap-physical-device.description: Requires a real device (biometric, hardware keys). Never runnable in CI.

@cap-theme-tint.description: Theme and tint switching (/theme, appearance settings).

@cap-messages-tool.description: Model-facing messages tool: bounded, session-scoped lookup of persisted message ranges.

@cap-image-annotation.description: Inline image markup and rasterised annotation (iPad-class devices).

@cap-text-highlights.description: Persistent text highlights and annotations on timeline messages.
